entries.zh: 走暗路、行邪路；误入歧途，行为不正
entries.en: to walk in a bad (dark) way; to go astray, live wickedly

entries.zh: 东奔西走；到处游走、来回奔波
entries.en: to go from here to there, roam about

entries.zh: 上上下下；来回上下走动
entries.en: to go up and down

entries.zh: 行路不著路；不循正道、走岔迷失（箸/著字形存疑）
entries.en: to stray from the road, fail to keep to the path
entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑:箸/著]，西语词头尾 no apartar 讹略；据行不著路与其闽南对音定不循正路、偏离之义。

entries.zh: 迷路；走入无路之处，失道而行
entries.en: to lose one's way, wander off the road (lit. and morally)
entries.notes: 西语尾注 moralix. 疑为 moralmente 之缩略（兼喻义），主干义 descaminado=迷路，与行無路去互证。

entries.zh: 走偏路、偏向一边；绕行僻径
entries.en: to walk aside, take an out-of-the-way (side) path
entries.notes: 西语词头 afora desejados 讹乱，疑为 afuera desviado（向外偏离），据行僻一邊定偏行义。

entries.zh: 行走江海之人；离乡远行奔波的行旅（疑指行商）
entries.en: one who travels the rivers and seas; an itinerant (merchant) far from his homeland
entries.notes: 西语词头讹乱，ma×cader 疑为 mercader、fuera de su tierra=离乡，与行江海人合观定远行行商义。

entries.zh: 行走江湖之人；闯荡四方、游走江湖者
entries.en: one who roams rivers and lakes; a wanderer about the world
entries.notes: 汉字栏带 + 标记，西语词头讹乱（embercados 疑为 embarcados，指乘船行走者），据中文各栏定江湖游走义。

entries.zh: 行海；航海、出海行走
entries.en: to travel by sea, to sail

entries.zh: 走直路；径直而行、抄直路走
entries.en: to go straight, take the direct (straight-line) road
entries.notes: 西语 rayo 旧义兼指直线，camino del rayo 即直路，与行直相合。

entries.zh: 行旅；出行在外、旅行奔波
entries.en: to travel, go on a journey
entries.notes: 西语词头 atratar 疑为 a tratar（外出贸易/交涉）之讹，中文三栏明确为行旅义，故从中文定释义。

entries.zh: 趋；快步疾走、大步赶路
entries.en: to hasten, hurry; stride quickly

entries.zh: 趋走；急步奔走、匆匆而行
entries.en: to walk hurriedly, scurry along

entries.zh: 趋奉；奔走侍奉、殷勤效力
entries.en: to hasten to serve, attend upon promptly

entries.zh: 趋赶；急急赶路、匆忙急行
entries.en: to hurry exceedingly, rush with great haste

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕急躁不安、举止躁动（趮/躁字形存疑）
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕(tentative: restless, impatient)
entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑:趮/躁]，音写栏含[残]与 T99 污损，西语词头 clerico/sobrino 讹乱，仅据残存材料暂拟急躁义。

entries.zh: 转；转动、旋转（轮转而行）
entries.en: to turn, revolve (as a wheel)

entries.zh: 转过；绕过、回转经过
entries.en: to turn past, go around
entries.notes: 词尾 amo p. baylan 8. 疑为他条互见标记（v. baylan），不影响本条转过释义。

entries.zh: 转换；变换、更换、交替
entries.en: to change, exchange, alternate

entries.zh: 煮沸、翻滚涌动（泉/煮字形存疑）
entries.en: to boil, bubble up (of juices/liquids)
entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑:泉/煮]，西语 bullendose（沸腾）与音写 chŷ 较近煮字，暂从煮沸义。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑:甭/甬]，音写 M(bôn) 与 R(hî) 相互分歧，西语词头 agatos/camastrandos 讹乱难解，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑:甭/甬]，音写 M(bôn pô) 与 R(hî hō) 分歧，西语 andar agoras 义不明，语义无法定夺。
